purpose: Teach: 課す/形容/メンツ/熟知/表向き/細々/退会/寄附

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、博士課程は厳しい課題を学生に課すぞ
lines.en: Ren — a PhD programme demands rigorous work from its students.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Speaking as someone who has seen this play out many times. No softening, but not unkind. A fact stated with the weight of experience behind it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文タイトルを一言で形容できるよう工夫します
lines.en: Yes. I'm working to distil my paper's thesis into a single clear phrase.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly cautious. Absorbing the advice. Quiet respect in the cadence. Not performing eagerness, but genuine attentiveness — the way you listen when you know someone is right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会では他大のメンツも尊重しろ
lines.en: Ren — at conferences, respect the reputation of researchers from other universities.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A teaching moment delivered without condescension. Clear enunciation on the key word. The tone of someone who has seen egos damage collaborations.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教授は分野を熟知してらっしゃいます
lines.en: Yes. My advisor knows this field deeply and steers accordingly.
lines.style: Deferential, almost carefully so. Acknowledging wisdom without claiming it. Soft on the closing — showing he understands the point about standing on the shoulders of the right people.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、表向きと裏の発表内容を一致させろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure what you present publicly and what you discover privately align.
lines.style: Direct, measured. No room for misunderstanding. Delivered as principle, not warning. A pause after the verb — letting it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の細々した作業も丁寧にしております
lines.en: Yes. Every detail of the research, no matter how small, receives careful attention.
lines.style: Careful reassurance. Each phrase deliberate. Not rushing to answer — proving through measured speech that he understands the seriousness. Slight tense in the present tense verb choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会員の退会原因を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — find out why members have been leaving the society.
lines.style: Practical concern beneath the surface. This is not idle curiosity. Delivered as a real problem that needs solving. Slight weight on the verb — this matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室は同窓会から寄附を頂いております
lines.en: Yes. Our lab has been fortunate to receive donations from alumni networks.
lines.style: Closing thought, measured and warm. Appreciative tone. The pace slows slightly — acknowledging gratitude and stability. Trails softly, as if reflecting on good fortune.
